S01E01.title: The One Where Monica Gets a Roommate

words.original: This is not even a date.
words.scene: 莫妮卡说和保罗出去吃饭不算是约会，大家在中央公园咖啡馆里调侃她。
words.example: Are you going on a date with him tonight?

words.original: I realize I am totally naked.
words.scene: 钱德勒讲述自己做了一个在食堂里全身赤裸的怪梦。
words.example: I walked into the wrong changing room and felt completely naked.

words.original: Finally, I figure I'd better answer it.
words.scene: 钱德勒在梦中听到电话响，最后决定接起来。
words.example: I figure we should leave before the rain starts.

words.original: It turns out it's my mother, which is very-very weird because she never calls me!
words.scene: 钱德勒在梦中接电话，发现是妈妈打来的，觉得很奇怪。
words.example: It's weird that he didn't show up for work today.

words.original: Carol moved her stuff out today.
words.scene: 罗斯难过地告诉大家，前妻卡罗尔今天把东西都搬走了。
words.example: I need to pack all my stuff before moving.

words.original: Okay, everybody relax.
words.scene: 大家围着罗斯开玩笑，莫妮卡让大家放松一点。
words.example: Take a deep breath and try to relax.

words.original: And you never knew she was a lesbian...
words.scene: 菲比直接点出罗斯离婚的原因，大家讨论卡罗尔是女同性恋。
words.example: She came out as a lesbian in college.

words.original: I don't want to be single, okay?
words.scene: 罗斯哭诉自己不想单身，只想再次结婚。
words.example: He's been single for two years now.

words.original: This really gorgeous Limoges gravy boat.
words.scene: 瑞秋回忆婚礼前看到一只精美的调味汁瓶，突然觉醒自己不爱巴瑞。
words.example: You look gorgeous in that dress.

words.original: And then I got really freaked out.
words.scene: 瑞秋意识到自己竟然对调味汁瓶比对未婚夫更有感觉，吓坏了。
words.example: Don't freak out, but I think I lost your keys.

words.original: It's a metaphor, Daddy!
words.scene: 瑞秋对父亲解释自己不想只做一只鞋子，这是人生比喻。
words.example: The phrase 'time is money' is a common metaphor.

words.original: You and I have kinda drifted apart, but you're the only person I knew who lived here in the city.
words.scene: 瑞秋逃到莫妮卡家，解释虽然两人疏远了，但莫妮卡是她唯一认识的人。
words.example: We used to be close, but we slowly drifted apart.

words.original: I was kinda hoping that wouldn't be an issue...
words.scene: 瑞秋说莫妮卡没被邀请参加婚礼，希望这不会成为问题。
words.example: Money is a sensitive issue in many relationships.

words.original: I was in the room where we were keeping all the presents.
words.scene: 瑞秋回忆婚礼前在放礼品的房间里看调味汁瓶。
words.example: I bought a present for my mom's birthday.

words.original: So you wanna tell us now or are we waiting for four wet bridesmaids?
words.scene: 钱德勒调侃瑞秋，问她要不要等四位湿漉漉的伴娘来了再说。
words.example: She asked her sister to be her bridesmaid.

words.original: I was looking at this gravy boat.
words.scene: 瑞秋看着一只调味汁瓶出神，意识到自己对婚姻的不满。
words.example: Please pass me the gravy for the mashed potatoes.

words.original: Independence. Taking control of your life.
words.scene: 莫妮卡鼓励瑞秋独立，掌控自己的人生。
words.example: She moved out to become more independent.

words.original: Joey and Chandler are coming over to help me put together my new furniture.
words.scene: 莫妮卡让瑞秋一起来组装新家具，乔伊和钱德勒会来帮忙。
words.example: We bought some new furniture for the living room.

words.original: We got a bookcase.
words.scene: 乔伊和钱德勒帮莫妮卡组装家具，以为装好了一个书架。
words.example: I need a bigger bookcase for all my novels.

words.original: I would have to say that is an 'L'-shaped bracket.
words.scene: 乔伊和钱德勒搞不懂剩下的零件，猜测是L形支架。
words.example: The shelf needs a metal bracket to support it.

words.original: You got screwed.
words.scene: 大家发现卡罗尔带走了家具和电器，罗斯什么也没得到，钱德勒说他被坑了。
words.example: I got screwed by that car dealership.

words.original: I'm such an idiot.
words.scene: 罗斯自责没发现卡罗尔每周看四五次牙医的真正原因。
words.example: I felt like an idiot for forgetting her name.

words.original: I shredded my old boyfriend's favorite bath towel.
words.scene: 菲比讲自己失恋后干过最坏的事，把前男友最喜欢的浴巾撕烂。
words.example: Could you hand me a clean towel?

words.original: I'm divorced. I'm only 26, and I'm divorced!
words.scene: 罗斯在咖啡馆里沮丧地宣布自己离婚了。
words.example: Their divorce was finalized last month.

words.original: That's like saying there's only one flavor of ice cream for you.
words.scene: 乔伊安慰罗斯，说世界上还有很多女人，就像冰淇淋有很多口味。
words.example: What's your favorite flavor of ice cream?

words.original: Stay out of my freezer!
words.scene: 乔伊用冰淇淋比喻女人，罗斯让他离冰箱远点。
words.example: I keep frozen vegetables in the freezer.

words.original: I haven't been able to, uh, perform.
words.scene: 罗斯向保罗倾诉自从卡罗尔离开后，自己在性生活上无法表现。
words.example: She performed well under pressure.

words.original: Rach, wait, I can cancel...
words.scene: 莫妮卡想为了陪瑞秋而取消和保罗的约会。
words.example: I had to cancel my dentist appointment.

words.original: I was laughed out of twelve interviews today.
words.scene: 瑞秋找工作失败，说今天十二场面试都被嘲笑出来。
words.example: I have a job interview tomorrow morning.

words.original: How'd you pay for them? Uh, credit card.
words.scene: 瑞秋买了打折靴子，大家问她怎么付的，她说是爸爸的信用卡。
words.example: I paid for dinner with my credit card.

expressions.original: C'mon, you're going out with the guy!
expressions.scene: 乔伊一语道破莫妮卡和保罗的关系，说他们在约会。
expressions.example: I heard she's going out with someone from her office.

expressions.original: I don't want her to go through what I went through with Carl.
expressions.scene: 乔伊不想让瑞秋经历自己曾经受过的情伤。
expressions.example: She's going through a tough time right now.

expressions.original: To hell with her, she left me!
expressions.scene: 罗斯假装大方祝福卡罗尔，随后改口说去她的，是她甩了我。
expressions.example: To hell with the rules, let's have some fun.

expressions.original: Why does everyone keep fixating on that?
expressions.scene: 罗斯不想大家一直围绕他是同性恋前妻的话题打转。
expressions.example: Don't fixate on your mistakes; learn from them.

expressions.original: Ooh, this is a Dear Diary moment.
expressions.scene: 瑞秋兴奋地说莫妮卡终于等到保罗约她，这是值得写日记的时刻。
expressions.example: Getting the job offer was a real Dear Diary moment.

expressions.original: Joey and Chandler are coming over to help me put together my new furniture.
expressions.scene: 莫妮卡邀请瑞秋来家里，乔伊和钱德勒会帮忙组装新家具。
expressions.example: It took me three hours to put together the desk.

expressions.original: Listen, while you're on a roll...
expressions.scene: 钱德勒见瑞秋会做咖啡了，调侃她既然状态好就再做个煎蛋卷。
expressions.example: She's on a roll, winning every game this week.

expressions.original: Welcome back to the world! Grab a spoon!
expressions.scene: 乔伊鼓励罗斯重回单身世界，像吃冰淇淋一样去认识不同的人。
expressions.example: The job market is hot—grab a spoon and apply everywhere.

expressions.original: You gonna crash on the couch?
expressions.scene: 瑞秋剪掉信用卡后，莫妮卡问她要不要在沙发上睡。
expressions.example: Can I crash on the couch tonight? I'm too tired to go home.

expressions.original: Back in high school, I had a, um, major crush on you.
expressions.scene: 罗斯向瑞秋坦白高中时曾暗恋她。
expressions.example: He had a major crush on her since freshman year.

S01E02.title: The One with the Sonogram at the End

words.original: For us, kissing is as important as any part of it.
words.scene: 瑞秋向男生们解释，对女生来说接吻非常重要。
words.example: They shared their first kiss under the stars.

words.original: Everything you need to know is in that first kiss. Absolutely.
words.scene: 莫妮卡赞同瑞秋，说初吻能说明一切。
words.example: Are you coming to the party? Absolutely!

words.original: I mean it's like the stand-up comedian you have to sit through before Pink Floyd comes out.
words.scene: 钱德勒把接吻比作演唱会前的暖场喜剧演员。
words.example: The comedian made everyone laugh at the club.

words.original: Well, she has issues.
words.scene: 大家在博物馆里看到罗斯的前妻，乔伊说她有问题。
words.example: He has some anger issues he needs to work on.

words.original: I'm pregnant.
words.scene: 卡罗尔在博物馆里告诉罗斯她怀孕了。
words.example: She found out she was pregnant last week.

words.original: Speaking of issues, isn't that your ex-wife?
words.scene: 菲比在博物馆里看到罗斯的前妻卡罗尔，提醒罗斯。
words.example: He remains friends with his ex-wife.

words.original: Marty's still totally paranoid.
words.scene: 卡罗尔和罗斯寒暄时提到家人玛蒂仍然很多疑。
words.example: Stop being paranoid; no one is following you.

words.original: I think this is the episode of Three's Company where there's some kind of misunderstanding.
words.scene: 钱德勒用电视剧里的误会情节来调侃罗斯的处境。
words.example: It was all a misunderstanding, and we're fine now.

words.original: I just don't wanna give them any more ammunition than they already have.
words.scene: 莫妮卡紧张地准备迎接父母，不想给他们更多挑剔的把柄。
words.example: Don't give your enemies ammunition to attack you.

words.original: You're like all chaotic and twirly.
words.scene: 瑞秋觉得莫妮卡因为父母要来而慌慌张张。
words.example: The kitchen was chaotic during dinner rush.

words.original: Yeah, calm down.
words.scene: 大家劝莫妮卡冷静，不要过于紧张父母的到访。
words.example: Calm down, it's not the end of the world.

words.original: Has anybody seen my engagement ring?
words.scene: 瑞秋找不到要还给巴瑞的订婚戒指，非常慌张。
words.example: He proposed with a beautiful engagement ring.

words.original: You got a beautiful lasagna here that looks good enough to avoid touching.
words.scene: 钱德勒调侃莫妮卡做的千层面虽然好看，但不许别人碰。
words.example: My grandmother makes the best lasagna.

words.original: Oh, like I wasn't dreading tomorrow enough, having to give it back to him...
words.scene: 瑞秋本来就害怕明天还戒指给巴瑞，现在戒指还不见了。
words.example: I dread going to the dentist.

words.original: I'm the girl in the veil who stomped on your heart in front of your entire family!
words.scene: 瑞秋想象自己还戒指时如何自嘲，说自己践踏了巴瑞的心。
words.example: The angry customer stomped out of the store.

words.original: Kinda puts that whole pillow thing in perspective, huh, Mon?
words.scene: 罗斯告诉大家卡罗尔怀孕了，让大家觉得枕头的事根本不算什么。
words.example: Losing my job put things in perspective for me.

words.original: Carol says she and Susan want me to be involved.
words.scene: 卡罗尔希望罗斯也参与孩子的生活，但决定权在他。
words.example: He wants to be more involved in his children's education.

words.original: I mean presumably, the biggest part of your job is done.
words.scene: 钱德勒调侃罗斯，说他在怀孕这件事上最大的贡献已经完成了。
words.example: Presumably, she'll arrive around noon.

words.original: And the most enjoyable.
words.scene: 乔伊接着钱德勒的调侃，说那也是最有意思的部分。
words.example: The trip was very enjoyable despite the rain.

words.original: They want me to go down to this sonogram thing with them tomorrow.
words.scene: 卡罗尔和苏珊邀请罗斯一起去做超声波检查。
words.example: We saw the baby on the sonogram for the first time.

words.original: No news, no little anecdotes to share with the folks?
words.scene: 罗斯爸爸问罗斯有没有什么新闻或趣事和父母分享。
words.example: He told a funny anecdote about his first day at work.

words.original: These people are pros.
words.scene: 钱德勒形容莫妮卡的父母是专业级别的挑剔高手。
words.example: Leave it to the pros; they'll handle it.

words.original: Identical? Yeah, people say we look alike.
words.scene: 钱德勒提到自己和双胞胎姐姐，大家说她们长得很像。
words.example: The two dresses are identical except for the color.

words.original: I did have an imaginary friend, who my parents actually preferred.
words.scene: 钱德勒自嘲小时候有个假想朋友，父母甚至更喜欢那个朋友。
words.example: Children often have imaginary friends.

words.original: As someone who's recently been dumped?
words.scene: 瑞秋问罗斯还戒指的建议，罗斯说自己刚被甩。
words.example: She dumped him after three months of dating.

words.original: You should try not to look too terrific, I know it'll be hard.
words.scene: 罗斯建议瑞秋还戒指时不要打扮得太好，以免刺激巴瑞。
words.example: You did a terrific job on the presentation.

words.original: Yes, and she's very supportive.
words.scene: 苏珊告诉罗斯，医生了解她们的特殊情况并且很支持。
words.example: My family has always been supportive of my decisions.

words.original: Why are you so tanned?
words.scene: 瑞秋见到巴瑞时发现他晒得很黑，原来他去了阿鲁巴。
words.example: She came back from the beach looking tanned.

words.original: And I'm an orthodontist.
words.scene: 巴瑞说自己是牙医，言下之意是他本可以伤害瑞秋但忍住了。
words.example: My orthodontist recommended braces for my teeth.

words.original: Knock knock! How are we today? Any nausea?
words.scene: 医生来给卡罗尔做检查，问她有没有恶心的感觉。
words.example: The medication can cause nausea in some patients.

expressions.original: For us, kissing is as important as any part of it.
expressions.scene: 瑞秋向男生们解释，接吻对女生来说和亲密关系其他部分一样重要。
expressions.example: Exercise is as important as a healthy diet.

expressions.original: Yeah, well, word of advice: Bring back the comedian.
expressions.scene: 瑞秋建议男生们要多接吻，就像让暖场喜剧演员返场一样。
expressions.example: Let me give you a word of advice: always save your work.

expressions.original: How about I'll catch up with you in the Ice Age?
expressions.scene: 罗斯不想和朋友一起面对卡罗尔，说冰河世纪再碰面吧。
expressions.example: I'll catch up with you later for coffee.

expressions.original: Are you through with that?
expressions.scene: 罗斯想拿走卡罗尔喝完的饮料杯，问她是否喝完了。
expressions.example: Are you through with the newspaper? I'd like to read it.

expressions.original: Having to give it back to him...
expressions.scene: 瑞秋发愁明天要把订婚戒指还给巴瑞。
expressions.example: Please give it back when you're done reading.

expressions.original: Because I think it might take some of the heat off me.
expressions.scene: 莫妮卡希望罗斯说出卡罗尔怀孕的事，让父母不再盯着自己挑剔。
expressions.example: His apology took some of the heat off the company.

expressions.original: We ran into her parents at the club, they were not playing very well.
expressions.scene: 莫妮卡妈妈提到在俱乐部偶遇瑞秋父母，他们对婚礼的事很不高兴。
expressions.example: I ran into an old classmate at the supermarket.

expressions.original: People like Ross who need to shoot for the stars, with his museum, and his papers getting published.
expressions.scene: 莫妮卡爸爸夸奖罗斯有远大抱负，在博物馆工作并发表学术论文。
expressions.example: Don't be afraid to shoot for the stars in your career.

expressions.original: Things change, roll with the punches.
expressions.scene: 苏珊劝罗斯接受现实，生活总会变化，要学会应对。
expressions.example: Life is unpredictable, so learn to roll with the punches.

expressions.original: Well, he's a big boy, he'll get over it.
expressions.scene: 瑞秋担心和艾伦分手会伤害他，莫妮卡说他是个大人会走出来的。
expressions.example: I know you're upset, but you'll get over it soon.

words.original: He walked me to the subway and said 'We should do this again!''
words.scene: 菲比告诉大家约会对象送她到地铁站，说了句客套话。
words.example: I take the subway to work every morning.

words.original: Loosely translated 'We should do this again' means 'You will never see me naked'.'
words.scene: 菲比解释约会用语，说'改天再约'其实是不会再见了。
words.example: This is a loosely based adaptation of the novel.

words.original: I'm gonna be dating leather-wearing alcoholics and complaining about them to you.
words.scene: 菲比解释'你人很好'的潜台词，暗示会去找别人约会。
words.example: He realized he was becoming an alcoholic and sought help.

words.original: Cushions the blow.
words.scene: 菲比说这些委婉语是为了缓和拒绝带来的打击。
words.example: A soft chair will cushion your fall.

words.original: Cushions the blow.
words.scene: 菲比解释约会时说好听话是为了让对方更容易接受被拒绝的打击。
words.example: Losing the game was a big blow to the team.

words.original: They had this unbelievable farm, and horses, and rabbits that he could chase.
words.scene: 罗斯回忆小时候家里的狗被送到农场，可以追兔子的美好画面。
words.example: The kids love to chase each other in the yard.

words.original: That's ridiculous!
words.scene: 乔伊听说可以用拇指尖到食指尖的距离判断某个尺寸，觉得很荒谬。
words.example: That's a ridiculous idea; it will never work.

words.original: Decaf cappuccino for Joey.
words.scene: 瑞秋当服务员越来越熟练，准确说出大家的咖啡订单。
words.example: I'll have a decaf latte, please.

words.original: I'm going through my mail, and I open up their monthly, you know, STATEMENT.
words.scene: 菲比查看银行每月寄来的账单，发现账户多了五百美元。
words.example: I check my bank statement every month.

words.original: There's five hundred extra dollars in my account.
words.scene: 菲比发现银行账户里莫名其妙多了五百美元。
words.example: I opened a savings account at the bank.

words.original: It's not mine, I didn't earn it.
words.scene: 菲比认为多出来的钱不是她赚的，所以不能要。
words.example: She earns a good salary as a software engineer.

words.original: It would be like this giant karmic debt.
words.scene: 菲比说如果把不属于自己的钱花掉，会欠下巨大的因果债。
words.example: He worked hard to pay off his student debt.

words.original: Think about what you went through the last time you quit.
words.scene: 大家劝钱德勒想想上次戒烟有多痛苦，不要重新开始抽烟。
words.example: He decided to quit smoking for his health.

words.original: You've been so good, for three years! And this is my reward!
words.scene: 钱德勒重新开始抽烟，自嘲这是自己三年不抽烟的'奖励'。
words.example: Getting a bonus was a nice reward for all my hard work.

words.original: Just give me a chance to figure that out.
words.scene: 莫妮卡说还需要时间想清楚自己对艾伦的感觉。
words.example: I need to figure out how to fix this computer.

words.original: They're like coyotes, picking off the weak members of the herd.
words.scene: 莫妮卡形容朋友们看到她带男人回家就会像土狼一样扑上去。
words.example: Coyotes are often heard howling at night in the desert.

words.original: Picking off the weak members of the herd.
words.scene: 莫妮卡比喻朋友们专挑她带回家的男生中的'弱者'围攻。
words.example: A herd of cows was grazing in the field.

words.original: Well, you do realise that the odds of that happening are a little slimmer.
words.scene: 钱德勒指出如果不让朋友见艾伦，他们喜欢他的几率就更小了。
words.example: The odds of winning the lottery are very low.

words.original: The odds of that happening are a little slimmer.
words.scene: 钱德勒说如果朋友们见不到艾伦，他们喜欢上他的可能性就更渺茫。
words.example: His chances of getting the job are slim.

words.original: Can't I whimper a little bit?
words.scene: 莫妮卡被大家说服，但还是想小声哭一下。
words.example: The puppy began to whimper when left alone.

words.original: The way his smile was kinda crooked.
words.scene: 大家夸艾伦笑起来有点歪，非常迷人。
words.example: The picture on the wall is a little crooked.

words.original: From the nursery rhyme.
words.scene: 钱德勒提到一首童谣里有个歪歪的男人，来形容艾伦的笑容。
words.example: She sang a nursery rhyme to her baby.

words.original: I think Alan will become the yardstick against which all future boyfriends will be measured.
words.scene: 菲比说艾伦会成为以后衡量莫妮卡所有男友的标准。
words.example: Good customer service should be the yardstick for every business.

words.original: We sure showed those Hassidic jewellers a thing or two about softball.
words.scene: 大家和艾伦一起打垒球并赢了比赛，非常兴奋。
words.example: Our company has a softball team that plays every Thursday.

words.original: Yeah, it's his, uh, innate Alan-ness that we adore.
words.scene: 大家调侃莫妮卡，说她们喜欢的是艾伦天生的艾伦气质。
words.example: She has an innate talent for music.

words.original: It's his innate Alan-ness that we adore.
words.scene: 朋友们都非常喜欢艾伦，夸他内在的特质。
words.example: I adore the way she laughs.

words.original: Did you pick out the vowels?
words.scene: 菲比给街头女孩莉琪带字母汤，问她是否挑出了元音字母。
words.example: A, E, I, O, U are the vowels in English.

words.original: Sure you don't wanna pretzel?
words.scene: 莉琪问菲比要不要买个椒盐卷饼。
words.example: I bought a soft pretzel at the mall.

words.original: So I have a flaw! Big deal?
words.scene: 钱德勒因为抽烟被大家批评，辩解说每个人都有缺点。
words.example: Perfectionism can be both a strength and a flaw.

words.original: Even nicer when everyone gets to wear their underwear.
words.scene: 莫妮卡感慨大家聚在一起真好，钱德勒调侃要是都穿着内衣就更好了。
words.example: Don't forget to pack clean underwear for the trip.

expressions.original: He walked me to the subway and said 'We should do this again!''
expressions.scene: 菲比说约会对象送她到地铁站时说'改天再约'，其实是不会再见了。
expressions.example: The dinner was fun; we should do this again sometime.

expressions.meaning: 不是你的问题（分手借口）
expressions.original: Like 'It's not you' means 'It is you'.'
expressions.scene: 菲比解释约会暗语，说'不是你的问题'其实意思就是'就是你'。
expressions.example: When he said 'It's not you, it's me,' I knew he was lying.

expressions.original: Cushions the blow.
expressions.scene: 菲比解释人们说委婉话是为了让对方更容易接受坏消息。
expressions.example: He offered me a small bonus to cushion the blow of the pay cut.

expressions.original: Put it out!
expressions.scene: 钱德勒又开始抽烟，大家让他把烟熄灭。
expressions.example: Please put out your cigarette before entering the building.

expressions.original: Keep the change.
expressions.scene: 菲比请莉琪喝汽水，剩下的零钱给她当小费。
expressions.example: Here's ten dollars; keep the change.

expressions.original: I bring a guy home, and within five minutes they're all over him.
expressions.scene: 莫妮卡抱怨每次带男人回家，朋友们五分钟内就会围上去。
expressions.example: The fans were all over the celebrity as soon as he arrived.

expressions.original: Joey, let it go.
expressions.scene: 乔伊缠着莫妮卡想见艾伦，莫妮卡让他别再提了。
expressions.example: I know you're angry, but you need to let it go.

expressions.original: I've decided to break up with Alan.
expressions.scene: 莫妮卡终于告诉朋友们她决定和艾伦分手。
expressions.example: She broke up with her boyfriend last weekend.

expressions.original: Well, he's a big boy, he'll get over it.
expressions.scene: 莫妮卡担心艾伦难过，钱德勒说他是个大人会走出来的。
expressions.example: It took him months to get over the breakup.

expressions.original: I should really get back to work.
expressions.scene: 瑞秋说该回去继续当服务员工作了，钱德勒调侃说她会让客人拿到真正点的东西。
expressions.example: Lunch is over; let's get back to work.
